gloss: taking into account; adding (a flavor or element)

definitions.explanation: Adding a further factor to what one already considers when judging or deciding, as in grading that also counts attendance. A formal word.

definitions.gloss: adding a flavor; adding an element
definitions.explanation: Adding a seasoning to food, or, more often figuratively, adding a new element or touch to something, such as humor to a story.

notes:
Literally "adding flavor". The pattern is A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{加味|かみ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: add B on top of A.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{加味|かみ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge with ... factored in
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{加味|かみ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take the circumstances into account
- ⟦ユーモア→ユーモア：00432_yuumoa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{加味|かみ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to add a touch of humor
